title_en: A function on the column stops the index from being used
title_hi: Column pe function lagane se index use nahi hota
fix_en: Compare the plain column against a range instead, e.g. created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND created_at < '2027-01-01' instead of YEAR(created_at) = 2026.
fix_hi: Column pe function ki jagah range use karo, jaise YEAR(created_at) = 2026 ki jagah created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND created_at < '2027-01-01'.

title_en: LIKE '%...' can't use a normal index
title_hi: LIKE '%...' normal index use nahi kar sakta
fix_en: Search from the start (LIKE 'abc%') where possible, or use a full-text index (MySQL FULLTEXT, PostgreSQL pg_trgm).
fix_hi: Ho sake to shuru se search karo (LIKE 'abc%'), warna full-text index use karo (MySQL FULLTEXT, PostgreSQL pg_trgm).

title_en: Large OFFSET reads and throws away many rows
title_hi: Bada OFFSET bahut saari rows padh ke chhod deta hai
fix_en: Page by the last seen id instead (WHERE id > last_id ORDER BY id LIMIT 50).
fix_hi: Pichli id ke hisaab se page karo (WHERE id > last_id ORDER BY id LIMIT 50).
